cases.disposition_reason: junie_tui::cli::parse in src/cli.rs exits from clap before any shell::run. Measured on the reference binaries, --help exits 0 and a bad argument exits 2. showcase parse_page in src/bin/showcase/main.rs says unknown page {value:?}. holla and jackin parse_scenario in src/bin/holla/main.rs and src/bin/jackin/main.rs say unknown scenario {value:?}. tablepro connection_index in src/bin/tablepro/main.rs says no connection named {name:?} and exits before shell::run. showcase parse_opt in src/bin/showcase/options.rs says expected KEY=VALUE, unknown option, or invalid value. apply_opt in src/bin/showcase/app.rs applies each OptSet in order, so a later chrome.brand replaces the earlier one and the chrome readout paints brand compact. An invalid option is not exit 0 and the full-screen UI is absent. Clap is built without wrap_help, so showcase --help is taller than 40 rows. The 120×40 and separate 80×24 frames both show Print help (see a summary with '-h'), --opt <KEY=VALUE>, and SHOWCASE_NO_MOTION from cli_after_help in src/bin/showcase/main.rs. The about line has scrolled off both viewports. The overview blurb stays absent. finish is used only after the later option is visible.
